effects.printed_clause: If your opponent controls more monsters than you do, you can Special Summon this card from your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: The inherent hand Special Summon procedure now has hard once-per-turn key id while retaining the opponent-more-monsters condition and free Monster Zone check.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Reveal the top card of your Deck; if it is a Skewy! card, add it to your hand, then if it is a monster you can Special Summon it. Otherwise, send it to the GY.
effects.lua_implementation: Mandatory delayed summon triggers confirm the Deck top. A Skewy able to be added is sent to hand and confirmed, then optionally Special Summoned if a monster; a non-Skewy able to be sent goes to GY.

official_references.matched_structure: Reveals/excavates the top card, adds on a match, otherwise sends it to GY.
Excavates the top card and branches between add and send-to-GY.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is sent to the GY: You can place 1 Candy Counter on 1 face-up monster your opponent controls.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed EVENT_TO_GRAVE trigger selects a face-up opponent monster able to receive one Candy Counter and adds it.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each effect of Skewy! Pumpki-Pal once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The summon procedure, summon-trigger effect, and GY trigger now use distinct hard once-per-turn keys id, id+100, and id+200; event clones still share the one key for the same effect.

official_references.matched_structure: Official once-per-turn self-Special-Summon procedure/effect records a named count limit.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: 'each effect' includes the printed summon procedure but does not make separate printed effects share one usage key.
